title: I built a ghibli style train sim world using Astra
author: aniketjatav
selftext:
Recently built this ghibli style train journey sim game. Where you navigate through floating towns and deliver passengers.

Entire build was done using Astra, cooked about half my weekly usage lol. Also used a 2.5d workflows, characters and some parts are 2d whereas the world is entirely 3d.

Game demo: Play here

comments.author: GratefulForGarcia
comments.body: Why does Astra reproduce the same exact UI? My game is completely different but still uses the exact same style and layout

replies.author: Rasrey
replies.body: You are using the same model with insufficiently specific prompts. Out-of-the-box Astra, if you will. If you want the model to behave any differently than it does with other people, you have to be a lot more granular with what you are doing and stop trying to make it produce end-to-end products in one or two prompts.

comments.author: TigOleBitties42069xl
comments.body: Im afraid to say what im making now cuz codex is so insane, that i think someone would steal my ideas now. Im making a turn based game for mobile. Since there are barely any. Its quite over ambitious. But its gonna be deeply inspired by clair obscur, epic seven, and gacha games. And its gonna be an AI gacha game. Gamers totally gonna fking hate me. Probably take me alteast 3 months to get it done.most of the mechanics are done. But most of wouldnt be possible without prior knowledge in unity,  blender, and all adobe software. I know which asset packs to get, understand and know how to make textures, 3d model. Blender helped a ton. Servers aint gonna be cheap too. But its insane what gpt astra can do for me eventhough i have minimal unity experience.
